definitions.explanation: The craft of making decorative or practical objects from wood, especially as a traditional art form. Encompasses joinery, carving, lacquered wares, and similar techniques.

examples.japanese: {木工芸|もっこうげい}を{習|なら}い{始|はじ}めた。
この{地方|ちほう}は{木工芸|もっこうげい}が{盛|さか}んだ。
{伝統|でんとう}{木工芸|もっこうげい}の{技|わざ}を{次|つぎ}の{世代|せだい}に{伝|つた}えていきたい。
examples.english: I want to pass on traditional woodcraft techniques to the next generation.

notes:
Compound of {木工|もっこう} (woodwork) + {芸|げい} (art, craft). Note the geminate っ: もくこう → もっこう.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {伝統|でんとう}{木工芸|もっこうげい}: traditional woodcraft
- {木工芸|もっこうげい}{家|か}: woodcraft artist
- {木工芸|もっこうげい}{品|ひん}: woodcraft items; wooden craft goods

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {木工|もっこう}: woodwork — broader, includes industrial woodworking
- {木彫|もくちょう}り: wood carving — narrower, focused on carving
- {指物|さしもの}: traditional joinery — wooden furniture made without nails
